papers.de_vries_1987: H. de Vries, C. W. de Jager, C. de Vries, 'Nuclear charge-density-distribution parameters from elastic electron scattering', At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 36 (1987) 495, Table I (charge-distribution parameters), the 6Li rows.
papers.angeli_marinova_2013: I. Angeli, K. P. Marinova, 'Table of experimental nuclear ground state charge radii: An update', At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 99 (2013) 69.

publishing_convention.quantity: <r^2>^1/2 of the nuclear CHARGE distribution in fm -- nucleon finite size INCLUDED (it is what the slope of the measured elastic charge form factor gives: F_C(q)/Z = 1 - q^2 <r^2>/6 + ...).  PER NUCLEUS (the distribution is normalised to the charge Z = 3); no per-nucleon quantity enters.
publishing_convention.errors: The parenthesised digits as the survey prints them, read here as one standard deviation on the last digits: 2.54(5) -> 0.05 fm, 2.56(5) -> 0.05, 2.57(10) -> 0.10, 2.589(39) -> 0.039.  Whether each analysis quotes 1 sigma, and whether statistical or total, was not checked.
publishing_convention.columns: 'model' is the survey's label (MI30, MI) printed verbatim and not interpreted here; 'q_range_fm-1' is the momentum-transfer range of the analysed data as the survey prints it; 'source_key' is de Vries's reference key as the survey prints it, with the survey's own expansion where it gave one (it gave none for Bu72).
publishing_convention.independence: NOT VERIFIED: whether the three analyses share data, and which data Angeli-Marinova's 2.589(39) rests on, are not stated anywhere in the tree.
